patch.description: EPIC-17/G04 remains In Progress through admitted V01→V02→V03 and safe merge. Admission: docs/planning/EPIC-17-ADMISSION.md. S458 current tally: 112 locally accepted / 34 pending integrated all-seven acceptance across 73 configurations / 146 faces; V01 Done, V02 In Progress, V03 Backlog. The former S457/board claim of a 0.68 cm Polo sleeve-cap residual against 0.25 cm was stale: current 17-option/34-face production replay verifies the exact approved S351 relation exception with zero such diagnostics; every other relation retains the 0.25 cm gate. Polo current revisions, output paths, 13 keyed POM/full-text rows per front and full-label audit pass local checks; final all-seven acceptance is still pending. Preserve V02-before-V03, legacy DXF behavior and protected export identities. V03 needs rights-reviewed receiver/version/profile and representative observed round-trip evidence before exact format claims. No physical-fit, factory-acceptance or production-readiness claim. Current status/evidence: docs/research/epic17/S458-polo-current-output-reconciliation/S458-exit-packet.md.
